tasks.prompt:
Which cancellation rule is valid for positive integer modulus m?
A. One may cancel c modulo m whenever c divides m.
B. One may cancel c modulo m when gcd(c,m)=1.
C. One may always cancel c modulo m when c is nonzero.
D. One may always cancel c modulo m when c<m.
Choose one statement and explain why it is correct. You may quote it instead of giving its letter.
